hypothesis_answer: Support at cost 2 is a frustrating tax, not an interesting expense.
why: Support acquisitions did not fall (7.4-7.6 per game versus 7.6 baseline): support is a requirement players pay at any price, so the higher cost only forces more Prestige farming. Median rounds rose 3 to 4 (24-25 to 27-29), holdout draws rose from 0.000 to 0.073 past the frozen guard, cancellations rose (7.81 to 8.68 holdout), and 5 games per suite ended the city phase by timeout with no player completing a collection set. Failed mechanical gates on both suites.
kept_numbers: Contest availability unchanged (afford 0.79-0.80, offered 0.66-0.67); all four profiles won; screen draws fell to 0.010.
